title: Layout template
interface: templates/base.html: Jinja layout with blocks title and content; header nav (Moje zařízení '/', for admins: /admin/assets, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/audit), current user e-mail and a logout form POST /auth/logout; flashed messages via get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true); links /static/style.css. Variables available in every template: user (dict email/is_admin or None). Czech UI text.
